extraction_notes:
This is a multi-product Pacific Life "Workforce Benefits Proposal" PDF (dental, vision, basic life/AD&D, voluntary life/AD&D, STD, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident). For the Basic Life and AD&D product specifically (section titled "Group Basic Term Life and AD&D Insurance", typically ~page 13-14), extract only these 2 rows:
1. A "Rate Summary" table near top of section with columns: Coverage | Lives | Estimated Volume | Monthly Rate Per $1,000. Rows are "Basic Life" and "AD&D" - these are the two flat-rate entries to extract (rate_per_unit = Monthly Rate Per $1,000 column).
2. Below that, a "Basic Life Plan - Employee Coverage" table gives Class (usually just one class "Class All"), Class Description, Benefit Amount (flat dollar amount, e.g. $20,000), Guaranteed Issue, and Maximum Benefit - use this for benefit_amount_formula and guarantee_issue_max fields on the Basic Life row.
3. A "Basic AD&D Plan - Employee Coverage" table states benefit amount equals Basic Life for that class - use same benefit amount for the AD&D row, with same guarantee issue (or note "equals Basic Life").
Employee contribution for Basic Life/AD&D is found in "Class All Basic Life Plan Details" table under "Employee Contribution" - typically "Non-Contributory" (100% employer paid).
Only one class ("Class All") was present in this document covering all eligible employees - confirm if future docs have multiple classes and extract each separately.
Do NOT extract Voluntary Term Life/AD&D (separate age-banded section), STD (age-banded rate table), Dental, Vision, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, or Accident products - those use different pricing structures (tiered or age-banded) and belong in other extraction schemas.
Document also has a cover page proposal ID (format P########), effective date, rate guarantee period, and situs state printed at top of each product section - capture effective_date from the Basic Life section header if needed.
